sections.title: Linking
sections.note: The passwords that link your files. A file is either the first game (it gives the Secret to Labrynna) or the linked one.

items.name: Secret to Labrynna
items.howTo: Beat General Onox in an unlinked Seasons game. The ending gives you the Secret to Labrynna: enter it under 'Secrets' on a new Ages file to play Ages as the linked sequel (or link the two Game Boy Colors with a cable instead).
items.reward: A linked Oracle of Ages game, continuing this file
items.notes: The secret carries over your animal companion and Bipin and Blossom's son.

items.name: Started with the Secret to Holodrum
items.howTo: Start this file under 'Secrets' with the Secret to Holodrum from a finished Ages game. It begins with 4 hearts and adds the linked events: the bonus Hero's Cave, Zelda, Queen Ambi, and Twinrova and Ganon after Onox.

items.name: Ring Secret
items.howTo: Ask the Red Snake at Vasu Jewelers for your Ring Secret and tell it to the Red Snake in the other game; then ask again and carry the merged secret back. It only works between files that share one linked history, and only once you've finished the game or started it with a secret.
items.reward: Your appraised rings merged into both files
items.notes: With two Game Boy Colors and a link cable, the Blue Snake does the same without a password; it can also give a Ring Fortune (one random ring each). Neither works on a Game Boy Advance or the 3DS.

items.name: Hero's Secret
items.howTo: At the end of a linked game, defeat Twinrova and Ganon in the Room of Rites. The ending gives you the Hero's Secret, which starts a new game in either Oracle.
items.after: The end of a linked game
items.reward: A Hero's game: an extra Heart Container at the start, the Victory Ring, and Ring Secrets shared with your earlier files
items.notes: Use it in the game you just finished to replay it unlinked, then link onward the other way round: the linked events (and rings like Power Ring L-3 and Armor Ring L-3) depend on which game came first. Finishing a Hero's linked game gives no new Hero's Secret.

sections.title: Secrets from Ages
sections.note: If you played Seasons first: secrets heard in the linked Ages game, told here.

items.name: Deku Secret
items.howTo: In your linked Ages game, hear it from the singing Deku Scrub in the far southwest of the Deku Forest (past). Here, tell it to the Deku Scrub in a cave in eastern Natzu, near Moblin's Keep west of Sunken City. You also get a return secret; tell it to Farore in Ages' Hall of Secrets to get the same reward there.

tiers.name: Reward here
Return secret told to Farore in Ages

items.name: Graveyard Secret
items.howTo: In your linked Ages game, hear it from the Ghini outside Syrup's Potion Shop in Yoll Graveyard (say you believe what you see). Here, tell it to the green Ghini in Holodrum's Graveyard, inside the one grave with no flowers (dig behind the tombstone second from the left in the first row). Red and blue Ghini copies flash by; say which there were more of, three times in a row. You also get a return secret; tell it to Farore in Ages' Hall of Secrets to get the same reward there.

tiers.name: Reward here
Return secret told to Farore in Ages

You also get a return secret; tell it to Farore in Ages' Hall of Secrets to get the same reward there.

items.name: Clock Shop Secret
items.howTo: In your linked Ages game, hear it from the Old Woman by the Ember Tree in South Lynna (present). Here, tell it to the Old Man in the cave behind the Clock Shop in Horon Village (dig behind the shop with the Shovel). Slay 12 enemies within 30 seconds. You also get a return secret; tell it to Farore in Ages' Hall of Secrets to get the same reward there.

Here, tell it to his golden brother in a cave near the three peaks of the Subrosian Volcanoes. Cut all the grass in his room with only three Boomerang throws. items.howTo: Hear it from Mamamu Yan's mother in the Floodgate Keeper's House in Spool Swamp. On your finished Ages file, tell it to Mamamu Yan in Lynna City. Find her lost dog somewhere in or just outside Lynna City and carry it back. You get the reward there plus a return secret; tell that to Farore in the Hall of Secrets here to get the same reward in this game.
